description: Buy for your key, on any pay chain: a balance (Buy GRID: 100 GRID of service per 1 dollar; it pays calls past the free allowance, grades, records and gateway requests) or a monthly plan (builder-99, team-199, protocol-299: 30 days of metered use at a better rate, paid up front, nothing renews by itself). Step 1, the quote (GET /v1/access/quote): pass usdc (a whole number 1 to 500) or plan, and chain_id (8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum One, 5042 Arc, 143 Monad: USDC; 4663 Robinhood Chain: USDG) → the unsigned token transfer to send from your own wallet, the message that wallet signs, the steps, and for_a_person (the page a person pays on). Step 2, with tx and signature (and the same chain_id, and plan when it is one): credit the key (POST /v1/access/topup or /v1/access/plan); a transaction credits once, and sending it again answers already: true. With tx and no signature: POST /v1/access/claim answers the messages that payment can be claimed with (a payment sent and not credited, for 7 days). Nothing is signed or sent by this tool. Needs your key. Your balance and plan: taifoon_access view "key".

signature.description: personal_sign of the quoted message by the wallet that sent the transfer

tx.description: the hash of your transfer on that chain
